owner_basis: Owner trigger 2026-11-01: competing backfilling v-layers, continuous, per DOE-FAMILY rule 8 (backfill doctrine). Backfill methods are themselves method versions: they compete, are compared version-over-version, and are culled/promoted only at significance.

corpora.provenance_attribution_set_repo_side: EXPERIMENT records under experiments/doe/*/records/ (the repo-side set carrying configured-instance stamps that Provenance attribution consumes). Extension not yet wired: the Neon HindSight ledger.

methods_in_competition.bf-strict v1: Intake-spec rule: a unit scores only with the full configured-instance tuple {provider, model@version, system_prompt ref+sha, tools ref+sha, role, moniker, context} or a precomputed instance_key; otherwise NOT_ESTABLISHED (observational).
methods_in_competition.bf-partial v1: Subset key {provider, model, role} when the full tuple is absent; scored but marked partial. Competes on coverage; fidelity risk = collisions (two strict keys under one partial key), measured on the gold subset.
methods_in_competition.bf-join v1: bf-strict keying plus a desk-feed join (provider + dispatch date) that recovers outcome fills {first_pass_success, rework_cycles, wall_time, stalled_action_required, pr} where the feed carries them. Competes on outcome completeness at strict fidelity.

responses: partial collisions on the gold subset
join outcome fills recovered + outcome completeness
decision_rule: No cull/promote before the standing gate (ESTABLISHED: n>=30 per compared class, minority>=10, p<.05). Readouts name candidates as watch-only until then. Comparison lines run continuously (weekly automation + on corpus change).

automation.emits: records/comparison-NNNN.json + records/SUMMARY.json (append-only comparison history = the version-comparison line)
